title: Blob Royale protocol v2 welcome data
description: Everything a session learns about itself, sent exactly once immediately after the upgrade and before any snapshot. accepted_command_kinds is an advertisement of what the boundary will accept from this client, not a grant: the server enforces the same set independently and InputBatch::create filters it a second time.

entity_id.$comment: The session's FIRST body only. An eliminated or match-reset body is destroyed and the server seats the same controller_id on a new entity_id, so a client that caches this value renders the wrong blob after one match. Resolve the own body by controller_id.

controller_id.$comment: Durable for the whole connection and the only stable self-identifier. A reconnect is a new join and receives a new controller_id.

accepted_command_kinds.$comment: maxItems tracks the size of common.schema.json#/$defs/command_kind. The published set is the intersection of the mode's accepted kinds with the client-sendable vocabulary, so it can never name a server-issued kind such as spawn or despawn.
